Designer Regular Week label remains61.9609375px with kerning /62.3095703125px without; it does not naturally produce an exact63px text advance. SemiBold and Bold must not replace the Figma-specified Regular400.

The designer package should be adopted by exact source bytes for canonical300/400/600/700 to align provenance; no synthetic metric or weight correction is justified. Full browser/visual and artifact verification remain integration-owner work.
The existing Figma intrinsic-frame discrepancy is not resolved by the designer file version alone.

Full shared Unicode cmap overlap was also compared by advance and decoded outline geometry; see unicodeOverlapComparison. This does not compare hinting instructions or every OpenType substitution sequence.
